caption: Create road branches and dead ends with lots-with-road.
content: With lot-with-road tiles @t{forest_open_road.l}, you can create road branches and dead ends. However, doing so requires enough space.

items: To create a road branch, you need an empty lot occupying at least 2 × 4 cells.
To create a road dead end, you need an empty lot occupying at least 2 × 3 cells.

content.caption: Example
content: Assuming your available tiles are @t{forest_road.2s.lr} @t{forest_road.2t.dr} @t{forest_open.1.dr} @t{forest_open.2s.r} @t{forest_open_road.r} and their rotations, let's solve these Areas.

In both Areas, @g{tips/complete_block/road/simple}{you can tell from the number of incoming roads that a road branch or a dead end is required}. There is only one way to create an empty lot of the required size without overlapping the roads in each Area, as shown below.
After that, you just need to connect the roads to complete the Areas.
